data.description: Lowest Price | 6BR + Maid | Private Pool | Hacienda
data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is proud to present this exceptional 6-bedroom plus maid's room villa in the highly sought-after Hacienda community at The Villa. Offered at AED 8,000,000, this represents one of the lowest-priced 6-bedroom villas currently available in the market, making it an outstanding opportunity for both end-users and investors.

Designed for luxurious family living, this spacious residence offers expansive interiors, elegant living and dining areas, and a thoughtfully planned layout that provides both comfort and privacy. The villa features six generously sized en-suite bedrooms, a well-appointed kitchen, a dedicated maid's room, and seamless indoor-outdoor living spaces ideal for entertaining.

Step outside to your private swimming pool and beautifully sized outdoor area, creating the perfect setting for family gatherings and relaxation. Situated within a peaceful, family-oriented gated community, residents enjoy a secure lifestyle surrounded by landscaped parks, children's play areas, and walking trails.

With convenient access to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Emirates Road, as well as nearby schools, retail destinations, and dining options, Hacienda remains one of Dubai's most desirable villa communities.

Property Features:

⦁ 6 Bedrooms + Maid's Room
⦁ En-suite Bathrooms
⦁ Spacious Living & Dining Areas
⦁ Well-Appointed Kitchen
⦁ Private Swimming Pool
⦁ Large Plot
⦁ Covered Parking
⦁ Unfurnished
⦁ Family-Friendly Gated Community

Whether you're searching for a spacious family home or a high-potential investment, this villa presents a rare opportunity to secure one of the best-value 6-bedroom residences in Hacienda.
